description: Canonical cross-platform crisis-language phrase contract. Two tiers: 'dialog' (client-side, pre-encryption detection that triggers the gentle support dialog) and 'suppress_extra' (server + client suppression of crisis-adjacent content from pattern cards and questions; the effective suppress tier is dialog + suppress_extra). CONSUMERS MUST NORMALIZE TEXT BEFORE MATCHING (see normalize_crisis_text in both engines): NFKC + casefold, strip invisible/format characters (zero-width, bidi, soft hyphen), fold homoglyph lookalikes (Cyrillic/Greek) to Latin, fold leet digits between letters (0->o 1->i 3->e 4->a 5->s 7->t 8->b @->a !->i $->s), turn remaining punctuation into spaces, then join runs of >=4 single-letter tokens (catches 's.u.i.c.i.d.e' and 's u i c i d e' without eating ordinary prose like 'i am so sad').
regex_rules: Every pattern must compile under BOTH Python re and ECMAScript RegExp. No lookahead/lookbehind. Consumers apply case-insensitive matching AFTER the shared normalization pipeline described in this file's description. \s+ for whitespace, ['\u2019]? for optional apostrophes, \b word boundaries (Latin-script patterns only — \b never fires next to CJK/Arabic/Devanagari in ECMAScript, so non-Latin patterns are plain substrings).
